oracleArtifact.attestation: digest-only -- release asset without provenance attestation or build commit stamp
oracleArtifact.note: Pinned by digest, not rebuilt. A self-built jar at the same commit was NOT byte-identical to this asset (16794 vs 16776 entries) -- see docs/phase0-spike.md section 'Q2'. The digest above is the contract; nothing here re-derives it.

selfBuiltArtifact.note: Measured during Phase 0 spike on a clean checkout at commit 318bb51a953c58a8785251a80fad8aea005f729f via ./mill flix.assembly. NOT the oracle -- recorded only to document that a same-commit rebuild is not byte-identical to the release asset (18 extra entries, most likely transitive-dependency drift). sizeBytes is deliberately absent: it was never measured, and a jar with 18 more entries cannot share the release asset's byte count.

buildProvenance.note: Provenance metadata only -- flix-spec's own build does not need to match this to consume the pinned artifact above (implementation plan section 3.2).

entryPoint.description: Phase pipeline, driven directly: Reader.run(List(Input.RealFile), AvailableClasses.empty) -> Lexer.run -> Parser2.run, with an implicit Flix. Chosen over the public API because it parses exactly the given inputs.
entryPoint.alternativeRejected: new Flix() -> addVirtualPath -> check() -> getParsedAst() is public and simpler, but getParsedAst() returns the CST for the entire compilation including the standard library (~1.03M projected nodes, 143 of 192 kinds for a one-line fixture), so every fixture expectation would embed the stdlib. Retained as the route for the corpus-wide reachability run, where that breadth is the point.

classpath.note: Must be loaded on the system classpath. URLClassLoader isolation hides dev.flix.runtime.Global and returns empty trees.
